task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Set the medium-sized bowl for holding food down, then add the dark inside bowl light blue outside over it.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架后放置中等大小的碗来盛放食物，然后将深色的内碗放在外面浅蓝色的碗上。
